description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding E1AP (E-UTRAN New Radio Application Protocol) messages related to bearer contexts, including filling ASN.1 structures for QoS flows, DRB setup, PDU sessions, and bearer context modifications and releases within the OCUDU (Open Cloud RAN) project.

methods.name: fill_asn1_qos_flow_info_item
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 QoS flow info item structure from internal QoS flow parameters.

methods.name: fill_asn1_drb_to_setup_item
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 DRB setup item structure from internal DRB setup data.

methods.name: pdu_session_type_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal PDU session type enum to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 bearer context setup request message from internal request structure.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_response
methods.description: Fills internal response structure from ASN.1 bearer context setup response.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 bearer context modification request message from internal request structure.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_response
methods.description: Fills internal response structure from ASN.1 bearer context modification response.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_release_command
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 bearer context release command from internal command structure.
